body.x: NYNE (www.nyne.com), a manufacturer of wireless Bluetooth speakers, introduced NYNE Aqua, NYNE Bass, and other products at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.

NYNE Aqua is a wireless watertight speaker that is shaped like a mini tri-hull boat when floating in the pool. The speaker remains dry and secure in water, submersible up to 3 feet. Its Bluetooth connectivity ranges up to 33 feet, and stream tunes for up to 10 hours per charge. The main hull features on-board controls and 4 equalizer settings that will satisfy any music enthusiast. It also has SOS call function, which sends emergency signals to family and friends when in danger.
NYNE Bass is a wireless Bluetooth speaker powered by a 10-hour rechargeable Lithium ion battery. It has a rubberized finish to endure touch conditions, and the sound is powered by 20 watts.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.

Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot. This year, AVING News is using smartphones for news reporting, in line with the trend of one-person media.
